final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT e.ID AS id, p.SEX AS sex, e."aCL IgM" AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(igm) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.id AS id, s1.sex AS sex, s1.igm AS igm, s1.igm - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT sex, AVG(d) AS ad FROM s3 GROUP BY sex) SELECT s3.id, s3.sex, s3.igm, s3.d, s3.d - s4.ad AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.sex = s4.sex WHERE s3.d > s4.ad ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
